dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「さすがに今日は遅刻も欠席もないみたいだね」

暦先生が出欠を取る間も、ほとんどの学生が下
を向いて教科書を見つめている。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi quietly took the attendance as the rest of the class
had their heads buried in their textbooks.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi quietly took the attendance as the rest of the class
had their heads buried in their textbooks.

dialogues.jp:
ぱっと見たかんじ顔をあげているのは、音夢ぐ
らいか……。
dialogues.en: As I look around, I can only see Nemu with her head up high.
dialogues.text: As I look around, I can only see Nemu with her head up high.

dialogues.jp:
いよいよ来た試験当日。さすがに遅刻も欠席も
いないようで、全員ぎりぎりまで教科書に向かっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
The first day of the exams has finally come. Everyone came
to school on time today, and using their last bits of time
studying for all they were worth.
dialogues.text:
The first day of the exams has finally come. Everyone came
to school on time today, and using their last bits of time
studying for all they were worth.

dialogues.jp:
いや、音夢だけは顔を上げているようだ。余裕
ですか――杉並もだった。
dialogues.en:
Then again, Nemu had had her head up and waiting. Suginami
as well.
dialogues.text:
Then again, Nemu had had her head up and waiting. Suginami
as well.
